en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a river scene with steam-powered ferries or boats at a crossing near small rural houses and forested hills. There is a church steeple and a prominent old building visible in the background. The caption on the front reads 'Indalen och Liden vid Lidens färja.' The reverse features handwritten Swedish text and is addressed to a Fröken Maria Lindborg in Bodacre, Liden. Printed text includes 'CARTE POSTALE UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE' and publication details by Max Sellmann, Mariedal.
